Statement: Pending points are posted once the purchase is more than 24 hours old.
Quote: AND created_at < SYSDATE - 1; -- return window: 24 h

Statement: Pending points are posted by one run per night.
Quote: Nightly job: post pending points older than 24 hours.
Reason: Legacy-only schedule: S-01 4.3 (docs/programme-terms-v3-excerpt.md:9) makes points available 24 hours after purchase and a nightly run can add up to a further day.

Statement: Members earn 1 point per SGD 1 spent, rounded down per transaction.
Quote: v_points := FLOOR(r.amount_cents / 100); -- 1 point per SGD 1, rounded down

Statement: Purchases at stores 17 and 23 made before 2019-12-31 earn triple points.
Quote: IF r.store_id IN (17, 23) AND r.created_at < DATE '2019-12-31' THEN ... XMAS2019 triple points, temporary
Reason: Probable obsolete rule: a hard-coded 2019 campaign marked temporary. Campaigns in general are covered by S-01 4.2 (docs/programme-terms-v3-excerpt.md:7).

Statement: The points earned on one transaction are capped at 5000.
Quote: IF v_points > 5000 THEN ... v_points := 5000; -- cap per transaction (ops request 2016?)
Reason: Legacy-only rule of uncertain origin; not in S-01.

Statement: When points are posted to a member with a negative balance, the negative balance is set to zero.
Quote: SET balance = GREATEST(balance + v_points, 0) -- never let balance go negative
Reason: Probable defect: writes off the negative balance that S-01 6.2 allows (docs/programme-terms-v3-excerpt.md:13), which understates the points liability.

Statement: Posted transactions are copied to a staging table for the CRM's nightly pickup.
Quote: INSERT INTO loy_txn_tmp (txn_id) VALUES (r.txn_id); -- staging for CRM nightly pickup
Reason: Implementation detail of the legacy CRM interface; the interface to Relay CRM belongs in system-context.

Statement: If posting fails for any transaction, the whole nightly run is rolled back and retried the next night.
Quote: WHEN OTHERS THEN ROLLBACK; -- whole batch is retried next night
Reason: Legacy-only behavior with a reliability cost: one failing transaction delays every member's points by a day.
